brief: Three-storey Second Renaissance Revival city hall on a street corner: rusticated stone ground floor, smooth ashlar above, a giant-order columned portico on the corner entrance, heavy cornice and balustraded parapet. Inside, a columned vestibule with a chandelier; flagpole and a war memorial on the lawn out front.

facade.notes: Norwood OH city hall (1916), HABS: a three-storey Renaissance Revival block on a corner, rusticated base with arched windows, a giant Ionic colonnade on the long side, low tile hip roof with a deep cornice; window air conditioners; men sitting on the steps, a phone booth

why.note: a civic building is a raised, symmetric block set apart by steps, lawn and a portico: the public building as a temple
